product_metadata.title: FolkArt Laser Cut Painting Stencil, Moorish Pattern
description: Rachel Faucett, the author-designer behind the popular blog, Handmade Charlotte, translates her modern, fun aesthetic into a line of functional, family friendly stencils. Designs are easy to use and come to life with FolkArt paint. Handmade Charlotte Bohemian Bazaar Laser Stencils.
